----------
howdy, it’s Barsee again.

happy friday, AI family, and welcome back to AI Valley.

**here are the biggest things worth knowing today:**

* Ex-xAI founders launch a time machine for AI

* Bullish on human intelligence

* Plus trending AI tools, posts, and resources

Let’s _dive_ into the Valley of AI…


----------

----------
#### **WISPR FLOW**

## [Walk-and-think (capture ideas on the move)](https://ref.wisprflow.ai/aivalley)

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/fe58964c-471c-4af7-ad88-302b0d2b1918/Newsletters_Image_1920x1080__7___9_.png?t=1794991549)
Follow image link: (https://ref.wisprflow.ai/aivalley)
Caption: _Courtesy: Wispr Flow_

Some problems don't solve themselves at a keyboard. Flow is perfect for walks: talk through the idea, the structure, and the tradeoffs, then get back a clean draft you can paste into your doc or AI tool. It's like having a writing assistant that keeps up with your brain in motion.

[Try Flow Free](https://ref.wisprflow.ai/aivalley)

~_*This is sponsored_~


----------

----------
#### **THROUGH THE VALLEY**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5135b4c5-9914-4325-994a-d97d9023895d/Article_CD__1___1___1_.png?t=1795789219)
Follow image link: (https://x.com/AravSrinivas/status/2125707364053680383)
Caption: 

**A time machine for AI, and a 7-cent people finder**

Two launches went viral this week, and they make more sense together.

Treg's [People API](https://www.launchvideo.com/directory/treg-4) lets an AI agent take one detail about you, like an email or a GitHub handle, and return whatever it can find: your job, your social accounts, sometimes your phone number. It costs seven cents a profile, nothing if it comes up empty. One user tried it on a well-known engineer's handle and, for [half a cent](https://x.com/Layton_Gott/status/2125624546854162918), got his career back to 2005. It's pitched at sales teams and recruiters, but anyone with the API gets the same access.

Most of what Treg returns comes from [data brokers](https://agihunt.info/en/p/1a21286dcc09c5b0e5883d1ac63) that have sold this for years. What's new is the effort. Looking someone up used to take time and money, and that hassle quietly protected us. Now an agent can run a thousand lookups while you make coffee. The brokers' [opt-out forms](https://smartscope.blog/en/blog/treg-contact-data-intermediary-across-140-providers-2026/) won't erase you, but they'll shrink what turns up.

Epochal, started by three of xAI's co-founders, built the opposite. Its [Time Portal](https://thenextweb.com/news/epochal-xai-cofounders-time-portal-forecasting) lets AI browse the internet exactly as it was on any day in the last 30 years, down to the computer's clock. That matters because you can't train AI on a future that hasn't happened, but the past is an endless supply of questions with known answers. Let AI practice on them without peeking, and forecasting becomes a skill you can drill. Perplexity clearly agrees: it just launched its own [Time Machine](https://x.com/AravSrinivas/status/2125707364053680383), already live in its APIs.

The catch is that you can rewind the internet, not the model. An AI trained this year may already know who won a 2024 election. Epochal's early test shows its portal [doesn't leak answers](https://www.forbes.com/sites/anishasircar/2026/11/27/former-xai-founders-built-a-time-machine-for-ai-agents-will-it-help-them-predict-the-future/), not that it makes AI a better forecaster. And like Treg, it's built on a trillion pages of old web without saying [where they came from](https://insideai.news/news/artificial-intelligence/epochal-ai-forecasting/16169/).

So that's where we are. Finding out about a stranger costs seven cents, while making an AI forget takes a trillion-page archive.


----------

----------
# TRENDING TOOLS


--------------------
* [Adobe Firefly](http://firefly.adobe.com) -** **direct the Adobe Creative Agent through Firefly AI Assistant to take on multi-step creative tasks while controlling the final result ^~(sponsored)~^

* [MAGI-2](https://sand.ai/blog/magi-2/) - Sand AI’s video generation model that matches Seedance 2.5

* [Scout](https://x.com/daviddotwalker/status/2122737484404756945?a=w8D3e5OYiroD2XAmg3o&s=20&utm_source=www.theaivalley.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=openai-unveils-gpt-6-2-astra) - an AI sales assistant that handles the busywork so reps can spend their time closing

* [Second](https://2.computer/?v=1&utm_source=www.theaivalley.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=openai-unveils-gpt-6-2-astra) - a portable AI model of you that you own and can take to any agent, so they know you without starting over

* [Replit Missions](https://x.com/amasad/status/2122754439886905593?a=K5_LLWrHRH5qqb5bhQs&s=20&utm_source=www.theaivalley.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=openai-unveils-gpt-6-2-astra) - give it a goal and a budget, and a swarm of agents works on it until the goal is done

* [Claude for Legal](https://x.com/claudeai/status/2115467192276025500?a=uxLvp_aQgzHM1tu8EpM&s=20&utm_source=www.theaivalley.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=google-built-a-game-engine-you-can-talk-to) - a gallery of ready-made artifacts for contract review, regulatory horizon scans, cite checks, and more

* [Echo-3](https://x.com/SpAItial_AI/status/2115081138415051124?a=c_tWUy-1sjNQrs3uVsQ&s=20&utm_source=www.theaivalley.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=google-built-a-game-engine-you-can-talk-to) - turns phone captures into photorealistic, metric-scale 3D worlds. From a single room to multi-floor buildings, outdoor and public spaces

* [terminal-mac](https://x.com/kirtandopamine/status/2117678349828976746?a=paLoOQwAFi-7hu9tYz0&s=20&utm_source=www.theaivalley.com&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=google-skip-ai-skip-search) - entire MacOS that runs inside your existing terminal. Computer use built in: MCP, CLI and skill. Free & open source

# WHAT I'M CONSUMING


--------------------

#### **THROUGH THE VALLEY**

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9063bc30-b26a-4746-b0ab-25357a7e50ef/1d558aa9dd6599dfad2f4ae46a5f7bcff085d8bb__1_.png?t=1795701317)
Follow image link: (https://x.com/ClaudeDevs/status/2125315491522650299?a=LrQR4cU_6WJdBWYtdrs&s=20)
Caption: Image Source: Anthropic

**Claude's **[**new desktop apps**](https://x.com/ClaudeDevs/status/2125315491522650299?a=LrQR4cU_6WJdBWYtdrs&s=20)** are tiny, clever and not quite real**

If you've seen Anthropic's demo video floating around this week and wondered what the fuss is about, here's the simple version.

When Claude built you something before, say a tracker or a little dashboard, it lived in a browser tab. Now you can hit ["Install as app"](https://claude.com/resources/articles/install-as-app) and it [lands in your Dock or taskbar](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/24/anthropic-just-gave-claude-users-a-new-way-to-make-mac-apps/) with its own icon, like anything else you'd download. You don't write code or set anything up. If you want it changed, you just ask Claude and the app updates. It's in beta, and it's on [every plan](https://dev.to/vladimir_beskorovainyi/claudes-install-as-app-needs-you-online-i-built-an-open-version-that-doesnt-f5o), even the free one.

People are already having fun with it. Someone started a ["Claude AppStore"](https://github.com/fengyiqicoder/claude-appstore) list on GitHub, and it's got a shooter game, a geography quiz, a Mac cleaner and a planet you colonize over 60 years. Honestly, though, I think the best uses will be boring. A shop owner who gets a ping at 4 pm when an order hasn't gone out. A student with a countdown to every exam. Stuff no developer would ever bother building for you.

Here's the "not quite real" part. Someone pulled one of these apps apart and found it's [404 KB](https://github.com/fengyiqicoder/claude-appstore), basically two tiny files and an icon that open a window inside Claude. That's why it won't work offline, why you have to stay signed in, and why everything it does eats into your usage limit. Another person asked Claude for the same app two ways and got two very different things back: a proper app that works without Claude but never changes, and an installed one that keeps changing but can't exist without Claude.

The bit I'd actually be careful with is [permissions](https://thenextweb.com/news/claude-install-as-app-artifacts-mac-windows-desktop). An app can ask for full access to your computer, which means running programs and reading, changing or deleting your files without asking you first. You can only give that to apps you built yourself, and Claude checks with you again after every update. But nobody at Anthropic reviews these apps, and turning access off later [won't undo](https://i10x.ai/news/claude-artifacts-install-as-app-mac-windows-permissions) anything an app already did. So I'd only say yes for apps I made and understand.


----------

----------
# TRENDING TOOLS


--------------------
* [Yoroll](https://code.yoroll.ai/?utm_source=ai_valley&utm_medium=newsletter&utm_campaign=black_friday_2026&utm_content=trending_tools_20261126) - turn an idea into a playable 3D game with Yoroll Code. Its team had a #1 product on Product Hunt ^~(sponsored)~^

* [Gemini 4 Neon](https://blog.google/intl/en-in/products/introducing-gemini-4-neon/) - mid-tier multimodal model for reasoning and agent tasks, with a 1M-token context window

* [Install as App](https://claude.com/resources/articles/install-as-app) - Claude beta feature that lets you install artifacts as standalone Mac and PC apps

* [Treg People API](https://x.com/treg_ai/status/2125546075855741424?a=syujNcuqTTiWUz9uCec&s=20) - API that looks up a person's identity details like phone number, personal email and social traces

* [MyClaw 3.0](https://myclaw.ai/) - build an always-on team of AI agents that share a common memory

* [MAGI-1](https://sand.ai/) - first autoregressive video model to deliver top-tier output quality

* [Perplexity Time Machine](https://x.com/perplexitydevs/status/2125676416834605488?a=65b11mttDKta5TRv3PA&s=20) - shows a model the web exactly as it looked on a date you choose

* [Ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama)** - **Runs large language models on your own machine. macOS, Windows, Linux, Docker, one-command setup

* [AutoGen](https://github.com/microsoft/autogen)** - **multi-agent framework: agents that talk to each other to solve a task, with customizable roles and proper docs


----------

----------
# WHAT I'M CONSUMING


--------------------
* The CEO of Anthropic thinks chat is temporary and talks about [what the next interface](https://x.com/okkshitij/status/2125623846934127008?a=ILgAKO1fMISju_8kMPQ&s=20) should look like
